title: The Rooftop Garden
text:
Nobody used the empty rooftop of her block until Mrs Tan carried up her first pot of chilli plants. Week after week, she watered them in the early morning before the sun grew fierce.
Soon her neighbours grew curious. One brought a bag of soil, another brought seeds, and a group of children built a small fence from old wood. By the end of the year, the bare grey roof had turned green with tomatoes, basil and lady's fingers.
On Sundays, the whole block eats together under the plants. Mrs Tan says a garden does not only grow vegetables. It grows neighbours into friends.
